name: Account Status Update Instruction Reason 1
definition: Reason for an update to an account status.

Code.name: Code
Code.definition: Reason for the instruction to change the account status.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information about the reason for the instruction to change the account status.

ReasonElementRule.definition: Either Code or AdditionalInformation must be present. Both may be present.
